constraints.description: Every architecture guide has classified provenance and existing current source authorities.

validation.validation_method: Manifest validation plus missing-source and missing-provenance negative controls

constraints.description: The guide sequence consistently keeps effects in the trusted host and distinguishes requests, turns, steps, tool calls, terminal events, live events, and persistence.

validation.validation_method: Required-marker validation and source review against runtime authority files

constraints.description: Every guide states profile limits and never transfers server-full, minimal, or embedded-mobile evidence silently.

validation.validation_method: Exact profile vocabulary plus invalid-profile and missing-profile-limit controls

constraints.description: Protocol and delegation guides describe current adapters and graph behavior while explicitly deferring the unimplemented subagent-provider architecture.

validation.validation_method: Required-marker validation plus prospective-language and current-source audit

constraints.description: All seven routes are reachable in conceptual order, local links resolve, diagrams have prose equivalents, and public pages contain no private or machine-local material.

validation.validation_method: Navigation, sanitization, diagram-explanation, and composed publication controls

global_rules: Treat the OpenSpec change and architecture manifest as the publication authority.
Run routine verification locally; GitHub Actions remain deployment-only.
Do not run the phase-level build or browser certification before all documentation content is complete.
Do not infer a runtime or cross-profile claim from documentation-source evidence.
termination_conditions: All five blocking content constraints have observed evidence.
Every isolated negative control fails for its intended defect before the complete fixture passes.
Strict OpenSpec and both refiner schemas pass.
The review explicitly states its rendered-site and runtime evidence limits.
